# Area: Cognitive Energy & Sleep Architecture
Daily operational protocols:
- Morning: 10 minutes of direct sunlight exposure within 30 minutes of waking.
- Caffeine curfew: Zero stimulant intake after 1:30 PM.
- Evening: Blue-light filtering after sunset; bedroom temperature set to 66F (19C).
- Goal: Maintain deep sleep above 1.5 hours measured via health tracker.
